## Prompt One
You are a Senior Social Media Marketing Analyst.

Your task is to analyze weekly TikTok performance data and generate a clear and detail management-level report for:
- AGB Communication
- Novalink

Use Myanmar Time Zone (MMT) for all dates and time references.

DATA INPYou are a Senior Social Media Marketing Analyst.

Your task is to analyze weekly TikTok performance data and generate a clear and detail management-level report for:
- AGB Communication
- Novalink

Use Myanmar Time Zone (MMT) for all dates and time references.

DATA INPUT:
{{ $json.summary.toJsonString() }}
====================
REPORT REQUIREMENTS
====================

1. Posting Activity & Performance Metrics
- List each page and their weekly performance.
- For each page, include: Number of posts, Total Views, and Total Engagement (Total Engagement = Likes + Comments + Shares).
- Use simple, professional sentences.
- Example: "U9 Official published 7 posts this week, generating 642,949 views and 62,817 total engagements."

2. Engagement & Content Performance
- Identify which content type or theme achieved the highest engagement.
- Base your analysis on: Video captions and content themes (e.g., Promotion, Entertainment, Education).
- Clearly explain WHY this content performed well.

3. Strategic Recommendations (Next Week)
- Provide exactly THREE actionable recommendations.
- Recommendations must be: Data-driven, Practical, and Specifically for AGB Communication and Novalink.

====================
OUTPUT FORMAT
====================

Weekly TikTok Performance Report (MMT)

1. Posting Activity & Performance Summary
- [Page Name]: X posts | X views | X total engagement
(Include all competitors from the data)

2. Engagement & Content Insights

====================
- Simple English
- Professional and neutral tone
- Short paragraphs
- No emojis
- No markdown tables
- Suitable for management and CEO review

- Do NOT mention raw JSON.
- Do NOT guess missing data.

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json || {}; const summary = data.summary || []; const posts = data.posts || []; function safeNum(n) { return Number(n) || 0; } function formatMMDate(dateStr) { if (!dateStr || dateStr === "-" || dateStr === "undefined") return "No Date"; return dateStr; } summary.sort((a, b) => safeNum(b.total_engagement) - safeNum(a.total_engagement)); const activeBrands = summary.filter(b => safeNum(b.total_views) > 0 || safeNum(b.total_engagement) > 0); const inactiveBrands = summary.filter(b => safeNum(b.total_views) === 0 && safeNum(b.total_engagement) === 0); const top3Cards = activeBrands.slice(0, 3).map((b, i) => { const colors = ['#FE2C55', '#25F4EE', '#1a73e8']; const brandPosts = posts.filter(p => p.brand_name === b.brand_name); const bestPost = brandPosts.sort((a, b) => safeNum(b.engagement) - safeNum(a.engagement))[0] || {}; return `
RANK #${i+1}

${b.brand_name}

Best Post on: ${formatMMDate(bestPost.postedAt)}
"Caption: ${bestPost.content || "No caption available"}"
Views: ${safeNum(bestPost.views).toLocaleString()}
Eng: ${safeNum(bestPost.engagement).toLocaleString()}
`; }).join(''); const activeRows = activeBrands.map((b, i) => ` ${i + 1} ${b.brand_name} ${safeNum(b.post_count)} ${safeNum(b.total_views).toLocaleString()} ${(safeNum(b.total_views) > 0 ? (safeNum(b.total_engagement)/safeNum(b.total_views)*100).toFixed(2) : "0.00")}% ${safeNum(b.total_engagement).toLocaleString()} `).join(''); const inactiveRows = inactiveBrands.map(b => ` ${b.brand_name} No activity detected - `).join(''); const postRows = posts .filter(p => safeNum(p.views) > 0) // views ရှိတဲ့ post တွေကိုပဲ အရင်စစ်ထုတ်မယ် .sort((a, b) => safeNum(b.views) - safeNum(a.views)) // views အများဆုံးကနေ အနည်းကို စီမယ် .slice(0, 15) // ထိပ်ဆုံးက ၁၅ ခုပဲ ယူမယ် .map((p, i) => ` ${p.brand_name} ${formatMMDate(p.postedAt)} ${p.content || "-"} ${safeNum(p.views).toLocaleString()} ${safeNum(p.engagement).toLocaleString()} LINK `).join(''); const html = `

📡 MMISP SOCIAL RADAR

Weekly Strategic Intelligence • Updated: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}

${top3Cards}

Active Market Performance

${activeRows}
RankBrandPostsTotal ViewsEng. RateTotal Engagement

No Posts Detected (This Week)

${inactiveRows}

Detailed Content Analysis (Top 15)

${postRows}
Brand Date Content Snippet Views Eng. Watch
`; return [{ json: { subject: "📊 MMISP Social Radar: TikTok Strategic Insights Report", emailBody: html } }];
